method.distributional: per-decision samples -> descriptives, percentile bootstrap CI, Cohen's d, Cliff's delta, Mann-Whitney U (tie-corrected normal approximation). Wilson is N/A (not a binomial proportion).
method.proportional: per-trial Bernoulli vector over the population AT RISK for that metric -> descriptives, Wilson 95% CI, bootstrap CI, two-proportion z-test, Cohen's h (arcsine proportion effect size), Cliff's delta and Mann-Whitney U on the Bernoulli samples.
method.composite: 300 seeded bootstrap replicates recomputed from the per-decision data -> descriptives + percentile CI; significance vs baseline from the bootstrap difference CI excluding 0. Structural planes with no sampling variation (ledger verify) are held fixed, which is why RIS CIs are narrow.
method.undefined: a metric that cannot exist under a configuration carries an explicit undefined_reason
